editorial.name: Detail
editorial.descriptionZh: 把产品里那些做得讲究的小决定一条条拆出来讲：标签栏分 Design、Interactivity、Motion、Copywriting、Accessibility、Easter Egg，每条配可动手的示例。
editorial.takeawayZh: 按 Design/Motion 标签翻小交互，照着改进界面
editorial.noteZh: 顶栏一排筛选写着 Design、Interactivity、Motion、Copywriting、Accessibility、Easter Egg，右边 Latest first 排序。卡片是两列瀑布流，标题就是一条条做法：Human-generated em dash 标 NEW 和 Easter Egg、Smart Corner Morph Animation 标 Motion、Hold to Reveal Shortcut Hint 写 Holding ⌘ teaches them every time、Clicking the Input Label Focuses the Input Field 标 Accessibility。左下角署名写 Detail collects the small decisions that make products feel considered. Curated by Rene Wang.

reasons.statement: 每条是一个界面细节的做法说明加示例（Hold to Reveal Shortcut Hint、Inline Regex Tester、Adaptive Text Color），按 Design / Interactivity / Accessibility 分类，是可供查阅与照做的模式参考。
站点自述是 A curated reference of small design decisions that shape better interfaces. For designers and engineers who care about the details.，交付参考而非代码或素材。
